post.title: Mastering the Strategy Pattern: Decoupling Algorithms and Behaviors
post.subtitle: A Low-Level Design Guide to Decoupling Algorithms and Behaviors
post.brief: The Strategy pattern is a behavioral design pattern that enables you to define a family of algorithms, put each of them into a separate class, and make their objects interchangeable. It allows the algorithm to vary independently from clients that use it.
